title: 目標達成の後に・かすかな芽生え

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto fears that she'll be abandoned and decides to leave on her own accord. However, I convince her to stay, and we resume our training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her body's starting to show signs of entering the race-ready state. If it continues, the Derby could very well be our next goal. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto is completely put off by the idea. Her heart has yet to catch up with her body. We go back to gaining gradual experience for the time being.
